items.name: Pentaline II
items.description: Salvaged from an office clear-out. It runs, in the sense that a fridge runs.

items.name: Quadra-4
items.description: Four honest cores. Everything you do feels a little less like waiting.

items.name: Hexon 6X
items.description: Six cores with room to breathe. The standard choice for working professionals.

items.name: Octane 8 Pro
items.description: Eight fast cores. Analysis jobs that took an evening take a coffee.

items.name: Titan 16
items.description: Sixteen cores of workstation silicon. Overkill, until it is not.

items.name: Spark 2G
items.description: An entry-level card. Enough to start crunching numbers on the side.

items.name: Blaze 8G
items.description: A mid-range card with real compute muscle.

items.name: Inferno 16G
items.description: A high-end card. The room gets warmer when it works.

items.name: Nova 48G
items.description: A research-grade accelerator. Built for labs, bought by the ambitious.

items.name: 4 GB (one stick loose)
items.description: Enough memory for one thing at a time, if that thing is small.

items.name: 8 GB Kit
items.description: Two matched sticks. You can finally keep two programs open.

items.name: 16 GB Kit
items.description: Room for several jobs side by side.

items.name: 32 GB Kit
items.description: Large captures and disk images fit in memory whole.

items.name: 64 GB ECC Kit
items.description: Error-correcting workstation memory. Nothing gets dropped.

items.name: 120 GB (makes a noise)
items.description: It was fast once. Now it mostly clicks.

items.name: 500 GB SATA
items.description: A plain, quiet, reliable drive. Clients' disk images load in seconds.

items.name: 1 TB SATA
items.description: Twice the room and noticeably quicker.

items.name: 2 TB NVMe
items.description: Straight on the board. Files open before you finish clicking.

items.name: 8 TB NVMe Array
items.description: Four drives working as one. Whole case archives stay online.

items.name: BlockHaus Residential
items.description: Shared with the whole building. Slows down when the neighbours watch films.

items.name: Fiber 100
items.description: Your own line. The contract board refreshes faster.

items.name: Gigabit Adapter
items.description: A proper gigabit link with a card that can keep up.

items.name: Multi-Link Bonded
items.description: Two bonded lines. One can fail and nobody notices.

items.name: Backbone Tap 10G
items.description: A ten-gigabit business line. New work reaches you first.

items.name: Stock Fan (dusty)
items.description: It spins. That is the kindest thing to say about it.

items.name: Tower Cooler
items.description: A big quiet heatsink. The CPU stops slowing itself down.

items.name: Liquid Loop 240
items.description: A sealed liquid loop. Full speed, all day.

items.name: Custom Loop
items.description: Hand-built tubing and a radiator the size of a book.

items.name: Phase-Change Unit
items.description: A small refrigerator for your processor. The neighbours ask about the hum.

items.name: 15" CRT
items.description: Heavy, curved and faintly green.

items.name: Dual 24"
items.description: Two flat screens. Logs on the left, notes on the right.

items.name: Ultrawide 34"
items.description: One long curved screen. Three windows fit side by side.

items.name: Four-Screen Wall
items.description: A two-by-two wall of screens. You can watch everything at once.

items.name: Holo-Projection Desk
items.description: A projection surface that fills the air above your desk.

items.name: Closet Server
items.description: A second-hand tower in the wardrobe, working while you sleep.

items.name: Half Rack
items.description: A real rack with real noise. Jobs queue up and run overnight.

items.name: Compute Cluster
items.description: Eight nodes behind one switch. A small lab of your own.

items.name: Private Data Hall
items.description: A rented cage in a data centre with your name on the door.
